rationale: Väljad keskenduvad sellele, kas ettevõte sobib (pilv, Kubernetes, suurus, etapp), kui kiiresti tal on kulude valu (värbamine, rahastus, kuluindikaatorid) ja kellele ning mida kirjutada (otsustaja, päästik, tootetüüp). Kõik on avalikest allikatest leitavad: tööpakkumised, inseneriblogi, Crunchbase ja LinkedIn.

fields.description: Public cloud platforms the company runs on (AWS, GCP, Azure, Hetzner and so on). Check job posts, engineering blog, case studies and the cloud vendor's customer pages.
fields.label: Cloud provider

fields.description: True if there is public evidence of Kubernetes use, such as job posts, a tech stack page, StackShare, GitHub repos with Helm charts or conference talks.
fields.label: Uses Kubernetes

fields.description: Infrastructure and DevOps tools mentioned publicly, such as Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, Datadog, Prometheus, EKS or GKE. Use job posts, the engineering blog and GitHub.
fields.label: Infra and tooling stack

fields.description: Approximate headcount from LinkedIn or the company site. It is used to check the 50-300 fit.
fields.label: Employee count

fields.description: Latest funding round and stage (Series A, B or C) with the amount and date. Use Crunchbase, Estonian news such as Startup Estonia or Ärileht, or press releases.
fields.label: Funding stage

fields.description: Date of the most recent announced funding round. Fresh funding and growing cloud bills raise urgency.
fields.label: Last funding date

fields.description: Open roles in DevOps, SRE, platform or cloud engineering, found on the careers page or job boards. A hiring push can signal infrastructure pain.
fields.label: Hiring for DevOps/SRE/platform

fields.description: Name and title of the CTO, VP Engineering or equivalent, from the team page or LinkedIn. The pipeline's contacts section holds the details. This field records who is the right buyer.
fields.label: Likely decision-maker

fields.description: Any public hint of cloud cost pressure or scale, such as talks about FinOps, cost-cutting posts, rapid user growth, layoffs or a cloud marketplace listing.
fields.example: CTO talk on rising AWS costs at DevOpsDays Tallinn 2026
fields.label: Cloud cost signal

fields.description: One line on what the B2B SaaS sells and to whom. Use it to tailor the opening line of the email.
fields.example: Fleet management SaaS for logistics firms
fields.label: Product type

fields.description: Latest news from the last 6 months worth mentioning in outreach: a product launch, expansion, new CTO, migration or an incident. Cite where it was found.
fields.example: Announced migration to a multi-region setup in September 2026
fields.label: Recent trigger event
